text:
But you exist there. Beside me. So close!
You bite an apple. And the apple exists.
You frown. You laugh. You are existing.
And you open your eyes so wide you kill my fear,
and give me the bitten apple that I bite.
So real is what I live, so false what I think
that—enough!—I kiss you!
To hell with verses,
and Don One, Saint X, and N plus Zero!
I am still alive, thanks to your love, my love,
and though all this is absurd, everything exists because you exist;
if you shine, there is no void, no reason for suicide,
no logical consequence. Because I live in you, I live myself,
and once again, thanks to you, I feel like a child.

translation.title: Final Dedication
